headline: Identity, control and operating status are answered. The file turns on two open items: the unsized liens, and whether a beneficial-ownership determination is required at all.

body.text: Two things are open against the policy: the unsized liens and litigation in Compliance, and the beneficial-ownership determination in Ownership that this record cannot produce at any price. The steps below close the file — the first is an order, the second a decision about what the policy will accept, and nothing else is blocking.

followUps.text: Order the lien and litigation detail — amounts, dates, and whether satisfied.
Settle whether the policy's beneficial-ownership requirement can be waived; no order will answer it.
Note the adverse-media matches as dismissed name collisions so a later reviewer does not re-open them as hits.
If good standing is gating, request the certificate — Delaware publishes no sub-status.
Re-run the registration search to clear the Delaware and New Jersey filings that returned no status.
